entries.question: I want my treatment how can I take appointment
entries.answer:
To receive treatment at KGMU, you must register for an appointment. Please note that online registration is mandatory.

### How to Book an Appointment:
1.  **Online Registration System (ORS):** Visit [ors.gov.in](https://ors.gov.in). Select Uttar Pradesh, then KGMU, choose your department, date, and time, enter patient details, pay the ₹50 fee, and download your slip.
2.  **ABHA/Health Care App:** Register using your mobile number and OTP, then follow the same process as the ORS portal.
3.  **SMS:** Send `Appointment [Patient Name]` to **8887019134**.
4.  **Walk-in:** Bring your Aadhaar card and an active mobile number to the hospital. You will receive an OTP, be issued a physical token, pay the ₹50 fee, and receive your OPD slip.

### Important Information:
*   **Fees:** There is a standard ₹50 OPD slip fee for all booking methods.
*   **Timings:** Monday–Friday: 9:00 AM – 1:00 PM; Saturday: 9:00 AM – 12:00 PM. The ticket counters close at 1:00 PM sharp.
*   **Referrals:** If you are traveling from outside Lucknow, please bring a valid referral letter from a doctor for the specific department you need to visit.
*   **Assistance:** For further help, you can call **0522-2258880** or **0522-3539333**.

**Medical Safety:** I am not qualified to provide medical advice or diagnosis. Please consult a doctor at the KGMU OPD for your health concerns. For your safety, please avoid sharing sensitive personal details like health records or Aadhaar numbers in this chat.

entries.question: What is a radio form ? Where can I get it so that if i am tranfer to IR department I can get my biopsy done? Can Assistant professor provide the form themselves or I have to get it from IR department itself
entries.answer:
A "Radio Form" (Radiology Requisition Form) is the official document required to request imaging services, such as a biopsy, from the Department of Radiodiagnosis. It contains essential patient information, clinical history, and the specific procedure requested by the treating physician.

Regarding your query:

1.  **How to get the form:** These forms are typically provided by the doctor or the department currently treating you. If you are being referred for an image-guided biopsy, your treating consultant or the Assistant Professor overseeing your case will fill out the necessary request.
2.  **Can an Assistant Professor provide it?** Yes. An Assistant Professor (or any authorized faculty member) in your current department is qualified to issue the requisition form. They will document the clinical necessity and the specific site for the biopsy.
3.  **Procedure:** Once the form is provided by your treating physician, it serves as the official referral for the Interventional Radiology (IR) team to perform the biopsy. You do not need to go to the IR department to "collect" a blank form; the form is generated by your primary care team.

**Important Notes:**
*   **Consultation:** Please ensure your treating doctor has coordinated with the IR department regarding the biopsy date and any pre-procedure preparations (such as blood tests or fasting requirements).
*   **Medical Advice:** I am an AI, not a doctor. Please confirm the exact process with your treating physician at KGMU, as they will manage the transfer of your records and the scheduling of your procedure.
*   **Safety:** Please avoid sharing personal medical details or patient identifiers in this chat.

entries.question: Can Assistant professor provide it in place of head doctor if head doctor has already transferred but didn't provide the form
entries.answer:
Yes, an **Assistant Professor** is fully authorized to sign and provide the Radiology Requisition Form. 

If your previous consultant or Head of Department has transferred or is unavailable, the current Assistant Professor managing your case has the authority to:

1.  **Review your medical history:** They will look at your existing records and reports.
2.  **Issue the requisition:** They can fill out and sign the required form for the Interventional Radiology (IR) department to ensure your biopsy is performed.
3.  **Ensure continuity of care:** It is standard practice for the faculty currently responsible for your treatment to provide any necessary referrals or procedure forms.

**Actionable steps:**
*   **Request the form:** Speak with the Assistant Professor currently overseeing your treatment. Explain that the biopsy was planned/recommended and you require the form to proceed with the IR department.
*   **Check for Departmental Stamp:** Ensure the form is properly signed and carries the official stamp of the department, as the IR department will require this for verification.

If you are unsure which faculty member to approach, you can visit the department's OPD office or the office of the Chief Medical Superintendent (CMS) for guidance on departmental authorization.

entries.question: In Hindi explain
entries.answer:
केजीएमयू (KGMU) लखनऊ में नर्सिंग या किसी भी अन्य कोर्स में प्रवेश (Admission) पूरी तरह से आधिकारिक मेरिट लिस्ट और विश्वविद्यालय द्वारा निर्धारित चयन प्रक्रिया पर निर्भर करता है।

प्रवेश से संबंधित महत्वपूर्ण बातें:

1. **आधिकारिक जानकारी:** एडमिशन के बारे में सटीक और सही जानकारी के लिए केवल केजीएमयू की आधिकारिक वेबसाइट [www.kgmu.org](https://www.kgmu.org) पर ही भरोसा करें।
2. **प्रक्रिया:** एडमिशन होगा या नहीं, यह आपकी रैंक, मेरिट और काउंसलिंग प्रक्रिया पर निर्भर करता है। इसके लिए आप [Courses & Admission](https://www.kgmu.org/courses_admission.php) पेज को नियमित रूप से चेक करते रहें।
3. **दिशा-निर्देश:** हाल ही में जारी "Bachelor Admission 2026 Instructions" को आप यहाँ देख सकते हैं: [क्लिक करें](https://www.kgmu.org/upload_file/user_download/be7ebaabc6f29a3ab8d2622fb1a4c178.pdf)

**जरूरी सलाह:**
* **सुरक्षा:** किसी भी अनजान व्यक्ति से फोन पर बात करके या उन्हें अपना मोबाइल नंबर, आधार कार्ड या अन्य निजी जानकारी देने से बचें। अक्सर एडमिशन के नाम पर धोखाधड़ी (Fraud) हो सकती है।
* **संवाद:** केजीएमयू के किसी भी आधिकारिक कार्य के लिए विश्वविद्यालय के रजिस्ट्रार कार्यालय (0522-2253171) या हेल्प लाइन (0522-2258880) पर ही संपर्क करें।

मैं एक AI हूँ और मैं आपको एडमिशन की कोई गारंटी या व्यक्तिगत सलाह नहीं दे सकता, लेकिन आप ऊपर दिए गए लिंक के माध्यम से आधिकारिक अपडेट प्राप्त कर सकते हैं।

entries.question: मेरे फादर को 24 हॉल्टर मॉनिटरिंग टेस्ट के लिए रेफर किया गया है ये जांच के लिए कैसे अपॉइंटमेंट लें?
entries.answer:
KGMU में 24-घंटे की हॉल्टर मॉनिटरिंग (Holter Monitoring) के लिए अपॉइंटमेंट लेने की प्रक्रिया निम्नलिखित है:

1. **ऑनलाइन अपॉइंटमेंट (ORS):** सबसे पहले आपको [ORS (ors.gov.in)](https://ors.gov.in) पोर्टल के माध्यम से कार्डियोलॉजी (Cardiology) विभाग में डॉक्टर का अपॉइंटमेंट लेना होगा। 
2. **OPD परामर्श:** अपॉइंटमेंट वाले दिन अपने पिता को कार्डियोलॉजी OPD में दिखाएं। हॉल्टर टेस्ट एक विशेष जांच है, इसलिए OPD में डॉक्टर ही आपके मरीज की स्थिति देखकर इस टेस्ट के लिए निर्देश देंगे और इसकी तारीख निर्धारित करेंगे।
3. **पर्ची और शुल्क:** OPD में डॉक्टर द्वारा दी गई सलाह (पर्ची) के आधार पर ही संबंधित विभाग में हॉल्टर टेस्ट के लिए प्रक्रिया शुरू की जाएगी। इसके लिए आपको निर्धारित OPD शुल्क (₹50) देना होगा।
4. **महत्वपूर्ण सूचना:** 
   - यदि आप बाहर से रेफर होकर आए हैं, तो कृपया अपने साथ डॉक्टर का ओरिजिनल रेफरल लेटर और सभी संबंधित मेडिकल रिपोर्ट अवश्य लाएं।
   - OPD का समय सोमवार से शुक्रवार सुबह 9:00 बजे से दोपहर 1:00 बजे तक और शनिवार को सुबह 9:00 बजे से दोपहर 12:00 बजे तक होता है।
   - अधिक जानकारी के लिए आप कार्डियोलॉजी विभाग के PRO ऑफिस से 9415099528 पर संपर्क कर सकते हैं।

**सुरक्षा सलाह:** कृपया अपनी निजी जानकारी, जैसे कि मरीज का नाम, फोन नंबर या आधार कार्ड का विवरण इस चैट में साझा न करें। अपनी स्वास्थ्य संबंधी समस्याओं के लिए कृपया सीधे संबंधित विभाग के डॉक्टर से परामर्श लें।

entries.question: Bhai main website mein Gaya to Bhai aap kya karun main usmein dekha to sab kuchh dikh raha Kitna kya fees lag Rahi Kitna
entries.answer:
KGMU ki website par aapko jo jaankari mili hai, uske aage kya karna hai, yeh is baat par nirbhar karta hai ki aap kis kaam ke liye wahan gaye hain:

1. **Agar aapko OPD mein dikhana hai:**
   - Online registration mandatory (anivarya) hai. 
   - Aap [ORS](https://ors.gov.in) ki website ya "ABHA/Health Care" app ke zariye appointment book kar sakte hain. 
   - OPD slip ki fee ₹50 hai. 
   - Bahar ke shehron se aane wale mareezon ko apne vibhag (department) ka valid referral lekar aana zaroori hai.

2. **Agar aap kisi exam ya admission ke liye gaye hain:**
   - Website par diye gaye latest notices (jaise "Bachelor Admission 2026 Instructions" ya "Exam Notice") ko dhyan se padhein.
   - Agar aapko kisi form ya fee submission se sambandhit koi dikkat hai, toh [Notice Board](https://kgmu.org/kgmu_notice_board.php) check karein.

3. **Agar aapko kisi vibhag (department) ka contact chahiye:**
   - Aap [IP Phone Directory](https://kgmu.org/ipphonedirctory.php) ya [PRO Office](https://kgmu.org/imp_numbers.php) ke numbers ka upyog kar sakte hain.

**Kuch zaroori baatein:**
- OPD ka samay: Somvar–Shukravar (9:00 AM – 1:00 PM) aur Shanivar (9:00 AM – 12:00 PM). Sunday ko OPD band rehti hai.
- Parchi/ticket counter 1:00 PM baje sharp band ho jata hai.
- Emergency ke liye aap seedhe **Gate 14 (Trauma Centre)** ja sakte hain.

Agar aap mujhe bataein ki aapka maksad kya hai (e.g., ilaj, admission, ya result), toh main aapko behtar raasta dikha paunga. 

*Note: Kripya apni personal details (Aadhaar, phone number, ya health records) yahan share na karein.*

entries.question: In Hindi explain
entries.answer:
KGMU ki website par fees aur baaki jaankari dekhne ke baad, aapko apne kaam ke hisaab se niche diye gaye kadam uthane chahiye:

**1. Agar aapko OPD (Doctor) ko dikhana hai:**
*   **Appointment book karein:** KGMU mein online registration zaroori hai. Aap [ORS](https://ors.gov.in) ki website ya 'ABHA' app par jaakar appointment book karein.
*   **Fees:** OPD slip ki fee ₹50 hai, jo aap online ya wahan counter par de sakte hain.
*   **Referral:** Agar aap Lucknow ke bahar se aa rahe hain, toh apne ilake ke doctor ka 'Referral Letter' zaroor saath layein.
*   **Samay:** OPD Somvar se Shukravar (subah 9 baje se dopahar 1 baje tak) aur Shanivar (9 baje se 12 baje tak) khulti hai. Sunday ko OPD band rehti hai.

**2. Agar aap Admission ya Exam ke liye dekh rahe hain:**
*   **Notice Board check karein:** [KGMU Notice Board](https://kgmu.org/kgmu_notice_board.php) par latest notices dekhein. Wahan exam ki dates, fee form, aur admission ki instructions di gayi hain.
*   **Form bharein:** Agar koi form online bharna hai, toh website par diye gaye link par click karke apni details bharein.

**3. Zaroori Salah:**
*   **Emergency:** Agar koi gambhir sthiti hai, toh website ka intezar na karein. Seedhe **Gate 14 (Trauma Centre)** chale jayein, wahan 24/7 emergency services chalti hain.
*   **Contact:** Agar aapko koi confusion hai, toh aap PRO Office ke number **9415007710** par sampark kar sakte hain.

**Ek zaroori baat:** Main ek AI chatbot hoon, isliye kripya yahan apna Aadhaar number, phone number, ya koi medical report share na karein. Yeh aapki suraksha ke liye zaroori hai.

Agar aap mujhe batayenge ki aapko **kya kaam hai** (jaise doctor ko dikhana hai ya admission lena hai), toh main aapko sahi link aur raasta bata paunga.

entries.answer:

Yahan kuch zaroori links aur baatein hain jo aapke kaam aayengi:

**Kuch ahem sujhav:**
* **Website check karte rahein:** Admission se judi saari dates aur merit list [kgmu.org](https://www.kgmu.org) par hi aayengi.
* **Sahyogi (Fake) logon se bachein:** Admission ke naam par kisi ko bhi paise ya apne documents na dein. KGMU mein admission sirf official merit aur counseling process ke zariye hi hota hai.
* **Category (SC):** Jab aap counseling mein jayenge, toh apna **SC caste certificate** aur baaki sabhi documents (original aur photocopy) taiyaar rakhein.
